title: Baselines for the I3-2 bias-only correction: wider parameter set, physical augmentation, low-dof shared corrections, GP discrepancy, in-sample per-device correction
iteration: exploration iteration 4, direction I4-1 (baseline comparison of I3-2); I4-2 interpretation analysis (reported, not deciding)
status: pre-registered before any B1-B5 held-out refit was run or scored. Done before this file: the B1 edge screen (out/research/explore/I4_1/b1_screen.json), which simulates the starting cards with one candidate parameter at a box edge and uses no fitted result of any arm; unit tests on toy data. Smoke runs (output directories smoke_*) check the code only and are not used for the decision
question: Does a simpler or physics-based change to the held-out refit give the same held-out strict paper RRMS as the I3-2 correction M_bias (g = tanh(MLP 3-16-16-1(is_pmos, |Vgs|/VDD, |Vds|/VDD)), I = I_card * exp(g), held-out card refit with g in the loop)?

stored_rows_used.C0_refit (B0): same files, per_device.C0_refit (I2-1 rows, identical settings)
stored_rows_used.T1_inloop: same files, per_device.T1_inloop (REAL_DEV: E1 stage-2 T1 rows; GF180/IHP: I3-2 run)

data.real: REAL_DEV (12) from out/research/explore/real_split.json; records out/research/explore/E1/real_dev.{npz,json}; starting cards out/research/polished/direct43_r3_fd/real/summary.json; base box = round-3 43-parameter box (out/cold_loop/full_direct/round_3/spec.json, cold_loop.box_for). REAL_TEST is not loaded by any I4_1 script
data.simulated: GF180 (BSIM4) and IHP SG13G2 (PSP103) tier c truth sets 0-2, 48 targets per PDK; records out/research/explore/E1/{gf180,ihp}_c_set{0,1,2}.{npz,json}; starting cards = E1 fitted cards stored in the records; base box = pdk2 'wide' box (GF180 21 parameters, IHP 12)
data.training_records_for_shared_corrections: B3 and B4 are trained post-hoc on the E1 stored training records of the fold (one NGSpice simulation of each training device's starting card), as M_bias

common_protocol.folds: REAL_DEV leave-one-device-out (12 folds); GF180/IHP leave-one-geometry-out (16 folds of 3 targets; the held-out geometry's 3 truth draws are removed from training)
common_protocol.heldout_refit: ngspice_fit.polish from the starting card, irls_rounds 2, diff_step 0.01, max_nfev 400 for arms on the base box (B3, B4, B5, C0 rerun). B1 and B2 have more active parameters; their max_nfev is set so that the per-IRLS-round TRF budget max(2, max_nfev // 2 // (n_active + 2)) equals the base-box value for the same device (i4_1_baselines.matched_nfev; base-box value: REAL_DEV 4, GF180 8, IHP 14 TRF evaluations per round). The best card seen is re-simulated with NGSpice and scored
common_protocol.scoring: strict paper RRMS with frozen inclusion (e1_correction.score_device: sky130 metrics.device_rrms_new with the published-baseline include tags; pdk2 target-frozen inclusion); NaN if an included curve is non-finite. Every scored current is a fresh NGSpice simulation of the refit card (with the B2 resistors in the netlist), multiplied by exp(g) of the frozen correction (B3, B4, B5) or by the B2 heating factor
common_protocol.reproduction_check: C0_refit_rerun: the C0 refit through the I4_1 refit path, compared with the stored C0_refit rows (max |diff| reported); not in the rule

arms.B0_C0_refit: stored; held-out card refit on the base box, no correction
arms.M_bias: stored I3-2 rows (PRIMARY method under test)
arms.T1_inloop: stored; per-(family, curve tag) gain table in the loop (non-deployable comparator); reported, not in the rule

B1.name: wider card parameter set, no correction
B1.definition: base box plus extra card parameters, all fitted jointly in the held-out refit (start: starting card, extras at their card values, so the start current equals C0's)

candidate_universe.sky130: the 115 BSIM4 candidates of out/pdk_parameter_sensitivity/summary.json minus the 43-set (72 names; values from out/pdk_parameter_sensitivity/readbacks.json, the device's bin)
candidate_universe.gf180: the same 115 BSIM4 names minus the GF180 wide set, where the device's stock bin defines a numeric value (79 names)
candidate_universe.ihp: PSP103 DC parameters listed in i4_1_baselines.PSP_B1_CANDIDATES minus the IHP wide set (92 names): effective geometry, threshold/doping, subthreshold/DIBL, mobility, series resistance, velocity saturation, CLM, impact ionization, gate current, GIDL. Excluded a priori: mode switches, temperature coefficients (ST*), stress/LOD, capacitance/overlap, noise, edge transistor (SWEDGE = 0), JUNCAP, expression-valued DLQ/IGINVLW/LOV

B1.box_rule: per device: if the parameter has an entry in i4_1_baselines.BSIM4_ZERO_RANGE and |card value| <= 1e-3 * max(|lo|, |hi|) of that entry, the box is that linear range extended to include the card value; otherwise a nonzero card value v gets the log-uniform box |v|/2 .. 2|v| with the sign of v; a zero value without an entry is inactive (lo = hi = 0)
B1.bsim4_zero_range_note: rdswmin upper bound = the device's starting-card RDSW
B1.screen: a candidate is kept if, on at least one starting card of the dataset (sky130: 12 REAL_DEV devices; GF180/IHP: the set-0 target of each of the 16 geometries), the edge response at either box edge is >= 1e-4; edge response = max over included curves of trimmed RMS(I_edge - I_start) / paper denominator (the threshold of the 43-set screen). Result: out/research/explore/I4_1/b1_screen.json (run 2026-10-20, 48 s)
B1.overlap_with_simulated_truth: the tier c truths perturb non-fitted parameters (pdk2.boxes.MISSPEC_PARAMS / IHP_MISSPEC_PARAMS, by exp(U(-0.25, 0.25))). GF180 B1 contains 9 of the 12 (a0, ags, lpe0, minv, drout, pscbe1, pscbe2, alpha0, beta0; not keta, etab, eu); IHP B1 contains all 9 (mueo, cto, fbet1, lp1, alpl, alplexp, axl, ctlexp, nsubo). On GF180/IHP, B1 can therefore represent the truth's parameter component; this is a property of the simulated tiers and is stated before the run

B2.name: physical augmentation, no learned term

elements.rext_ohm: extrinsic series resistance per side: equal resistors RDEXT (drain terminal to card drain) and RSEXT (card source to ground) in the NGSpice netlist, outside the card; body at the external ground. Box linear [0, 4 * R_side / W], start 0, where R_side = 0.5 * RDSW_start (sky130: divided by W_um * mult; GF180) or RSW1_start (IHP) in ohm*um. sky130 netlist via spice_pdk.simulate_pdk(rs_ext_ohm=...) (added for I4-1; deck unchanged at 0); GF180/IHP via the backends' existing rs_ext_ohm
elements.heat_kappa: first-order self-heating factor applied to the NGSpice current: I = I_spice * exp(kappa * |Vds * I_spice| / P_max), P_max = max over the device's included trimmed points of |Vds * I_measured| (fixed per device); box linear [-0.5, 0.5], start 0

B2.note: the GF180/IHP tier c truths contain an extrinsic resistance per side (k * R_side_stock / W, k ~ U(1, 2)) and a per-curve temperature rise (curve i at 27 C + dT_max * P_i / max P, dT_max ~ U(20, 40) K). The B2 resistance has the truth's form; the B2 heating term is pointwise and multiplicative, not the truth's per-curve temperature. Stated before the run

B3.name: low-dof shared correction (deployable, bias-only)

arms.B3_d2: total degree 2 (6 coefficients per polarity, 12 total)

B3.form: g = OUT_SCALE * tanh(P_pol(u, v)), OUT_SCALE = 1; u, v = |Vgs|/VDD, |Vds|/VDD standardized with the fold training-point mean/std; P_pol = sum over i + j <= d of c_pol,ij u^i v^j with separate coefficients for nMOS and pMOS. Same output map as M_bias; only h differs
B3.training: E1 loss (mean over training devices of the paper per-device RRMS of I_sim * exp(g)) + 1e-4 * sum of squared non-constant coefficients; Adam lr 3e-3, 2000 full-batch steps, zero initialization, float64 (deterministic, one fit)
B3.use: frozen; held-out card refit with g in the loop (base box), as M_bias

B4.name: Kennedy-O'Hagan-type discrepancy (shared)
B4.target: y = ln|I_target| - ln|I_sim| (starting-card simulation of the training records) at the included trimmed points with both magnitudes >= 1e-13
B4.kernel: k(x, x') = sf2 * exp(-0.5 * sum_{j=1..3} ((x_j - x'_j) / ell_j)^2) + sn2 * delta(x, x'); ARD squared exponential with a separate length scale for is_pmos (cross-polarity correlation exp(-0.5 / ell_1^2)); constant mean m
B4.hyperparameters: type-II maximum likelihood of (m, sf2, ell_1..3, sn2) on the fold's training points: exact Gaussian log marginal likelihood, L-BFGS-B (torch gradients, float64, maxiter 200) from m = mean y, sf2 = var y, ell = (1, 0.3, 0.3), sn2 = 0.1 var y; bounds ell in [0.02, 50], sf2 in [1e-4, 1e2] var y, sn2 in [1e-6, 10] var y
B4.points: 2000 points per fold: floor(2000 / n_training_devices) per device, uniform random without replacement (numpy default_rng(0), devices in record order); all points of a device if it has fewer
B4.g: posterior mean m + k(x, X) (K + sn2 I)^-1 (y - m); no clipping, no tanh
B4.use: frozen; held-out card refit with g in the loop (base box)

B5.name: per-device correction, in-sample upper reference (not a held-out method)
B5.protocol: g0 = M_bias-form ensemble (3-16-16-1 tanh, 5 seeds, I3-2 recipe) trained on the held-out device's own starting-card record; held-out card refit with g0 in the loop (base box); g1 = same recipe trained on the refit card's record; score = refit card corrected with g1. Also reported: refit card with g0, starting card with g0
B5.role: reference only; not in the rule

evaluation.aggregates: all-device mean (12 devices or 48 targets), combined = mean of the nMOS and pMOS family means, median, per-device values, failed count
evaluation.decision_statistic: GMR(M_bias, X) = exp(mean_i ln(rrms_M_bias_i / rrms_X_i)) over devices where both values are finite and > 0 (failed devices counted and reported); bootstrap 95% CI = 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles over 10000 resamples (numpy default_rng(0)) of devices (REAL_DEV) or of geometries (GF180/IHP, 16 clusters of 3 targets); wins = devices with rrms_M_bias < rrms_X. Computed with i3_2_bias.paired_ratio. Also reported: GMR(X, C0_refit) for every arm and GMR(M_bias, T1_inloop), GMR(M_bias, C0_refit)

criterion.rule: For each baseline X in {B1, B2, B3_d2, B3_d3, B4}: X is beaten if (a) the upper bound of the bootstrap 95% CI of GMR(M_bias, X) over the 12 REAL_DEV devices is < 1, or (b) the point estimate of GMR(M_bias, X) over the 48 leave-one-geometry-out targets is < 0.95 on GF180 and < 0.95 on IHP. I3-2 is 'supported against baselines' if every X is beaten; otherwise the result is 'matched by baseline X', listing every X that is not beaten.

I4_2_interpretation_analysis.role: reported, not deciding; uses stored I3-2 fold models (out/research/explore/I3_2/{real_dev,gf180_c_logo,ihp_c_logo}/corrections.json, keys M_bias|<fold>) and stored records; no simulation
I4_2_interpretation_analysis.g_surface: g of each fold model on a 41 x 41 grid of (|Vgs|/VDD, |Vds|/VDD) in [0, 1]^2 for nMOS and pMOS; mean, standard deviation, min and max over the fold models (12 REAL_DEV, 16 per PDK); heat-map PNG per dataset
I4_2_interpretation_analysis.physical_signatures: on each device's included trimmed measured points, with the device's own held-out fold model: Vth = maximum-transconductance linear extrapolation on the measured Id-Vg curve with the smallest |Vds| (|Vg*| - |I*|/gm* - |Vds|/2); regions subthreshold |Vgs| < Vth, saturation |Vgs| >= Vth and |Vds| >= |Vgs| - Vth, linear otherwise, high_vds |Vds|/VDD >= 0.6; per polarity (pooled points): mean g per region, point-biserial correlation of g with each region indicator, Pearson correlation of g with the starting-card log residual ln|I_meas / I_start|
I4_2_interpretation_analysis.t1_comparison: per held-out device and included curve: the fold's E1 T1 gain for (family, curve tag) (out/research/explore/E1/{real_dev_lodo,<pdk>_c_logo}/fold_corrections.json) vs the mean of the fold's M_bias g over that curve's included trimmed points; Pearson correlation and mean |difference|, overall and per curve kind

data_reuse_note: REAL_DEV has been used by E1, I2-1, I3-2 and its follow-ups. I4-1 REAL_DEV results are development evidence, not a held-out test. REAL_TEST is loaded only at the method freeze

compute.real: one queue job, process pool (4 workers, 1 torch thread each)
compute.simulated: one queue job per PDK (6 workers)
compute.order: real first, then GF180, IHP, decide, analyze; one heavy job at a time (queue runner)
compute.smoke: 1 fold, B5 1 seed, B3/B5 200 steps, full refit settings; output smoke_* directories, labelled smoke, not used for any conclusion

frozen_choices_note: All choices above were fixed before any B1-B5 held-out result existed. No result is used to change them; a later variant gets a new id or a dated amendment that leaves this file unchanged
